method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across strength received and life offered, obedience made visible in conduct, humility before the unknowable, the heart nourished and sheltered, service with wisdom and utterance, the covenant sustained together, particular lives held in prayer, steadfastness amid suffering, discernment under pressure, gratitude for awakening, trust and detachment before the divine will, and love preserved through changing conditions. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. Imported wording checked separately; version differences remain explicit. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to assist us in raising the banners of gratitude and praise amidst all created things, and to grant us the Kawthar of steadfastness in Thy Cause and the Salsabil of firmness in the path of Thy love.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s communal prayer to raise banners of gratitude and be granted the Kawthar of steadfastness and Salsabil of firmness.

selected.text: O my God! I beseech Thee by this Most Great Name that Thou make me steadfast in His love and His good-pleasure, in such wise that I turn to none except Him, and hold fast to none but Him, and accept none save Him.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer in the Lawh-i-Munajat to turn to, hold fast to and accept none but the Most Great Name.

selected.text: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the Kawthar of Thy utterance and the exaltation of Thy Word and Thy standing before the faces of Thine enemies, to make me steadfast in Thy remembrance and praise amongst Thy servants.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Kawthar of utterance and His standing before enemies to be steadfast in remembrance and praise.

selected.text: O my Lord! Sever me from all that keepeth me back from turning toward Thy beauty, then make me steadfast upon the path of Thy love in such wise that the souls of all the sinful idolaters shall not cause me to slip.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to be severed from all that keeps him from God’s beauty and set steadfast on the path of love.

selected.text: My God, my God! My hope is in Thy nearness and my desire is Thy good-pleasure. I beseech Thee … to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love and detached from all else but Thee and speaking in Thy praise
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that names nearness as his hope and good-pleasure as his desire, asking steadfastness, detachment and praise.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty amidst all created things to assist this handmaiden of Thine to stand firm in Thy Cause and to hold fast unto that which will exalt her among Thy handmaidens
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that a handmaiden stand firm and hold to what exalts her among the handmaidens.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my God, to assist me to remain steadfast in this Cause whereby the feet of the learned have slipped save those whom Thy mercy - which hath preceded the worlds of the seen and unseen - did encompass.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to remain steadfast where the feet of the learned slipped save those encompassed by mercy.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast unveiled the mysteries from the faces of the righteous, that Thou make me steadfast in Thy love and grant me Thy presence and honor me with the visit of Thy Beauty.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition to be steadfast in love and granted the divine presence; sets steadfastness within longing for nearness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the letters of Thy Book and by the Ha through which Thou didst manifest the station of pure Identity, to make me patient in the occasions of Thy decree and steadfast when the tempestuous winds blow.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Ha of pure Identity to be patient under the decree and steadfast when tempestuous winds blow.

selected.text: My God, my God, my Lord and my Support! Praise be unto Thee for having guided me unto Thy straight path and illumined my heart with the light of certitude. I beseech Thee … to aid me to remain steadfast in Thy love
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for a heart illumined with certitude and plea to remain steadfast in love.

selected.text: Through the pure and special favors of His Holiness the Self-Subsisting One (may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones), I beseech confirmation of steadfastness and firmness, and protection from trials and tests
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s request for steadfastness and protection from trials through the favors of the Self-Subsisting One.

selected.text: O Lord, O Lord! Give them to drink from the cups of joy in the first life, intoxicate them with the choice wine of bounty in the next life, and make them signs of guidance, lamps of righteousness, and angels of heaven.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the friends drink the cups of joy in this life and the wine of bounty in the next, becoming lamps of righteousness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Self and by them who have offered up their souls in Thy path to aid this handmaiden of Thine to make mention of Thee and to extol Thee among Thy handmaidens, and to make her steadfast in Thy Cause
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that a handmaiden extol God among the handmaidens and be steadfast.

selected.text: O Lord of all names! I beseech Thee by the Crimson Scroll and by the Ark which Thou hast specially ordained for the people of Baha, to assist me in all conditions to remember Thee, to praise Thee and to serve Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s distinctive invocation of the Crimson Scroll and the Ark ordained for the people of Bahá, asking for remembrance, praise and service in all conditions.

selected.text: the door of Thy generosity, and the unlettered one turneth toward the ocean of Thy knowledge and wisdom. I beseech Thee by that treasure which Thou hast deposited in the hearts of them that are sincere amongst Thy servants to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, firm in Thy love and standing ready to serve Thee. Praise be unto Thee, O my God
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer as the unlettered one turning to the ocean of knowledge, asking by the treasure deposited in sincere hearts to be steadfast and ready to serve.

selected.text: O Lord! Aid Thy servants to recognize Thy Self and that which Thou hast willed through Thy power and sovereignty. Then enable them to act in accordance with what Thou hast commanded them in Thy Scriptures and Thy Tablets.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that servants first recognize God and His will and then act as commanded in Scriptures and Tablets; sets recognition before obedience.

selected.text: O Lord! Illumine their hearts with the light of Thy knowledge, and adorn their heads with the crowns of trustworthiness amidst Thy creatures, and their temples with the ornament of detachment through Thy grace and mercy.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that hearts be illumined with knowledge and heads crowned with trustworthiness and temples adorned with detachment; carries the guide’s link between firmness and trustworthiness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the Light that shone forth from the horizon of Sinai and by the Fire which Thou didst manifest from the Tree of Revelation, to make me firm in Thy love, steadfast in Thy Cause, and speaking in Thy praise.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Light of Sinai and the Fire from the Tree of Revelation for firm love and steadfastness.

selected.text: make me sincere before Thy generous countenance, passionate for Thy manifest beauty, clinging to Thy strong cord, holding fast to Thy ancient covenant, firm and steadfast in Thy mighty testament, walking upon the straight path
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer to be sincere, passionate, clinging to the strong cord and steadfast in the testament while walking the straight path.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause in such wise that neither the lowing of any calf nor the croaking of any crow nor the swords of those who have arisen to extinguish Thy light shall prevent me
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that neither the lowing of any calf, the croaking of any crow nor the swords of opponents prevent him; a vivid closing image of opposition.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having remembered me and enabled me to recognize Thee when most of mankind have turned away from Thee. I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance to assist me to remain steadfast in Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for recognizing God when most of mankind turned away, asking to remain steadfast.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the sovereignty of Names to make me steadfast in Thy service, speaking Thy praise, holding fast to the cord of Thy grace, and standing firm in this Cause whereby the limbs of the people of Thy kingdom have trembled.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to be steadfast in service, hold the cord of grace and stand firm in the Cause that made the limbs of the kingdom tremble.

selected.text: My God, my God! By Thy power, raise up one who will arise to serve Thy Cause in such wise that nothing whatsoever shall deter him, nor shall the might of potentates frighten him, nor shall the clamor of the powerful weaken him.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that God raise up one who will serve undeterred by the might of potentates or the clamor of the powerful.

selected.text: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy power which hath encompassed all things, and by Thy bounty through which existence hath appeared from the unseen and the seen, to assist whosoever hath turned toward Thee to be steadfast in Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s intercession by the power encompassing all things for whosoever has turned to God to be steadfast in His Cause.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Ocean of Bounty, by Thy Most Great Signs, to enable me and Thy loved ones to stand firm with supreme steadfastness, and ordain for me and for them that which befitteth the heaven of Thy grace and the sun of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition that he and the loved ones stand firm with supreme steadfastness; shows constancy asked for oneself and others together.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by this Promised One, through Whom Thou hast fulfilled Thy promise, manifested Thy sovereignty, and revealed that which lay hidden in Thy knowledge, to aid me to serve Thy Cause and to arise in service to Thy loved ones.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Promised One through Whom God fulfilled His promise to serve the Cause and the loved ones.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God, my Lord, my Helper and my Strengthener! I beseech Thee by those who were martyred in Thy path and gave up their spirits in Thy good-pleasure, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy service.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition by those martyred in God’s path to be steadfast in the Cause and firm in service; links constancy with sacrifice.

selected.text: My Lord! I am Thy servant, and the son of Thy servant, and the son of Thy handmaiden. I beseech Thee by Thy mysteries which lie hidden within Thy knowledge, that Thou make me steadfast in Thy remembrance and praise amongst Thy servants.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer as servant, son of a servant and son of a handmaiden to be steadfast in remembrance among the servants.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having made Thyself known unto me, shown me Thy horizon, and remembered me in Thy prison. I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, a servant unto Thy Countenance, and one gazing upon Thy face.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for being remembered in God’s prison, asking to be steadfast and a servant gazing on His face.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Him Who sacrificed Himself for the exaltation of Thy Word and the manifestation of Thy Cause, to make me in all conditions hold fast unto the cord of Thy bounty and cling to the hem of the robe of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by Him Who sacrificed Himself for the Word to hold the cord and robe in all conditions.

selected.text: Glory be to Thee, O my Lord, my God, my Goal and my Beloved! I beseech Thee by the Manifestation of Thyself, the Dayspring of Thy verses and the Source of Thy power, to make this servant of Thine steadfast in Thy love and Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Manifestation, Dayspring of the verses, to be steadfast in love and Cause.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the stars of the heaven of Thy utterance to aid me in Thy remembrance and praise in such wise that neither the might of the world nor the tumult of the nations shall deter me.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for remembrance and praise undeterred by the might of the world or the tumult of nations.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O God of existence and Lord of the seen and unseen! I beseech Thee by the Word whereby Thou hast distinguished between Thy loved ones and Thine enemies, to make me steadfast in Thy love and speaking in Thy praise.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Word that distinguished loved ones from enemies for steadfast love and praise.

selected.text: Therefore, O my God, since his hands are cut off from the mantle of Thy nearness and reunion with Thee, let not the cord of Thy loving-kindness and the handle of Thy favors be cut off from his heart … Then make his feet firm upon the path
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s intercession that one whose hands are cut off from nearness not be cut off from the cord of loving-kindness, and that his feet be made firm.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest me clinging to Thee and to that which hath appeared from Thee. I beseech Thee to assist me in all conditions to remember Thee and to remember those who have circled round Thy Most Great Cause and Thy Mighty Announcement.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to remember God and also those who circle round the Most Great Cause; remembrance of others as part of steadfastness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the mysteries of the ocean of Thy knowledge to confirm me in such steadfastness as shall not be prevented by the doubts of the learned nor the signs of the divines nor the power of rulers
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for steadfastness unimpeded by the doubts of the learned, the signs of the divines or the power of rulers.

selected.text: O my Lord! Confirm me to serve Thy beloved and to be submissive and humble before Thy chosen ones. Make me to know the meaning of Thy Words and inform me of the mysteries of Thy signs. Place me in the shadow of the standard of Thy Testament
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer to serve the beloved, be humble before the chosen ones and learn the meaning of the Words; joins steadfastness with humility and understanding.

selected.text: My God, my God! Strengthen the hearts of Thy loved ones in such wise that the hosts of the heedless and the denial of the opposers shall not weaken them. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Supreme over all who are in the heavens and the earth.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the hearts of the loved ones be strengthened so that neither the heedless nor the opposers weaken them; keeps the stated purpose of strength.

selected.text: O my God! O my God! These are servants who have hastened to the shade of the tree of Thy Covenant … They have stood firm in Thy Cause, remained steadfast in Thy love, and sprouted from the rain of Thy clouds and the outpouring of Thy heaven
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s description of servants who hastened to the shade of the tree of the Covenant and sprouted from the rain of divine clouds; an early image of steadfastness as growth.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God and the God of all, the Sender of the Messengers and the Revealer of the Books! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance that Thou disappoint me not from steadfastness and from that which is with Thee.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to the Sender of the Messengers not to be disappointed of steadfastness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to ordain for me that which will make me steadfast in Thy Cause, such that neither the masses and multitudes would prevent me, nor the oppression of the aggressors and the tyranny of every sinful transgressor would frighten me
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for steadfastness that neither multitudes nor the oppression of aggressors can frighten.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy luminous countenance and by the denizens of the Most Exalted Paradise to ordain for me that which shall make me steadfast in Thy service, Thy remembrance, and Thy praise amongst Thy creatures.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition by the denizens of the Most Exalted Paradise to be steadfast in service, remembrance and praise.

selected.text: O Lord! Aid us to remember and praise Thee and to do as Thou hast commanded us in Thy Tablets … I beseech Thee to assist us in that which Thou hast commanded us outwardly in Thy Book; then ordain for us what befitteth our relationship to Thee
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s communal prayer to do what is commanded in the Tablets and outwardly in the Book; obedience made concrete.

selected.text: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having awakened me through the breathings of Thy Revelation, made known to me Thy ancient bounty, and shown me Thy wondrous generosity. I beseech Thee...to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love.
selected.original: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having awakened me through the breathings of Thy Revelation, made known to me Thy ancient bounty, and shown me Thy wondrous generosity. I beseech Thee...to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love.  BH07994
selected.reason: Provisional rendering of Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer of thanks for being awakened through the breathings of Revelation, asking to be made steadfast in the Cause and firm in love; closes the guide’s arc with gratitude for awakening.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having guided me, and made me known to Thee, and caused me to hearken unto Thy call whereby the hearts of Thy sincere servants and those who have recognized Thy oneness among Thy creation were attracted.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for guidance and for hearing the call that attracted the hearts of the sincere.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee for having bestowed Thy favor upon this servant of Thine and guided him to the straight path, and made firm the foundation, and granted success in remaining steadfast on a Day when the pillars of all created things were shaken
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s thanks for guidance and for success in remaining steadfast on a Day when the pillars of all things were shaken.

selected.text: I beseech Thee to make me one of those steadfast handmaidens whom the affairs of creation have not prevented from turning unto Thee. Verily, Thou art the All-Hearing, the Answerer of prayers. Verily, Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to be among the steadfast handmaidens whom the affairs of creation did not keep from God.

selected.text: O God of the world! I beseech Thee by the Most Great Name to make me in all conditions one who uttereth Thy praise, who taketh refuge in Thy presence, who seeketh protection at Thy threshold, who remaineth firm in Thy love and steadfast in Thy Cause
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to be one who takes refuge in God’s presence, seeks protection at His threshold and remains firm and steadfast.

selected.text: My God! Aid him to remain steadfast with perfect and complete firmness, preserve him in Thy most secure sanctuary, and facilitate for him that which he loveth and with which he is well-pleased. Verily, Thou art the Guardian of the people of fidelity.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the one addressed remain steadfast with perfect firmness and be preserved in the most secure sanctuary of the Guardian of the faithful.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest one of Thy handmaidens and another handmaiden of Thine who have turned unto Thee and desired to carry out what Thou hast commanded them in Thy Book. Ordain for her that which will make her steadfast in Thy love, then accept her deed.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for two handmaidens who wish to carry out the commandments of the Book, asking that her deed be accepted.

selected.text: O Lord! I heard Thy call and turned toward Thee. I beseech Thee by the Dawning-Place of Thy verses, the Recipient of Thy Revelation, and the Source of Thy Command, to make me steadfast in Thy love, speaking forth Thy praise, and serving Thy chosen ones.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s response to having heard the call, asking to be steadfast in love, speaking praise and serving the chosen ones.

selected.text: O God of kings and the Merciful One to the servants and the Ruler of the Kingdom! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the rains were caused to fall and the seas to surge and the trees to speak, that Thou assist me to be steadfast in this Cause
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Name through which the rains fell, the seas surged and the trees spoke for steadfastness in this Cause.

selected.text: Therefore I beseech Thee, O Desire of the world, by this standing and sitting, that Thou make me steadfast in Thy remembrance and praise in such wise that the hosts of Thine enemies and the might of those who have denied Thy signs shall not frighten me.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition by His standing and sitting to be steadfast in praise so that enemies’ hosts shall not frighten him.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, by the appearance of divine knowledge and by the waves of the ocean of Thine utterance, to ordain that I may, in all conditions, be moved to celebrate Thy praise and arise to serve Thy Cause with the wisdom Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition to arise and serve the Cause with the wisdom sent down in the Book; practical direction for service.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou seest me confessing to that which the Tongue of Thy Grandeur hath spoken in the Kingdom of Thine utterance. Strengthen, O my God, my heart and my limbs such that neither the power of the mighty nor the doubts of the learned may weaken them.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to strengthen heart and limbs against the power of the mighty and the doubts of the learned.

selected.text: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having admitted me into the seat of the throne of Thy grandeur and for having revealed Thyself unto me through the lights of Thy countenance. I beseech Thee by Thy Self to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks in the Lawh-i-Abdu’r-Rahim for admission to the seat of the throne and a plea for steadfastness.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy sovereignty which hath encompassed the world and by Thy Most Great Name whereby Thou hast subdued the nations to ordain for me steadfastness in Thy remembrance and praise and in acting according to what Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for steadfastness in remembrance, praise and acting according to the Book.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the Self-Subsisting, to assist me to be steadfast in Thy love and to act according to what Thou hast sent down in Thy Book. Verily Thou art powerful over what Thou willest and in Thy grasp are the reins of creation.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Name, the Self-Subsisting, to be steadfast in love and to act according to the Book.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Thou the Possessor of existence and the Educator of the seen and the unseen, to make me one of those who have aided Thy Cause and have arisen to serve Thee. Then ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for Thy trusted ones and Thy chosen ones.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition to be among those who aided the Cause and arose to serve, sharing the lot of the trusted and chosen ones.

selected.text: to make me steadfast in Thy love and holding fast to the cord of Thy bounty. My Lord! Ordain for me of Thy generosity and munificence that which will make me independent of all else save Thee, and mighty among Thy creatures, and firm and immovable in Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition to be made independent of all but God, mighty among creatures and immovable in the Cause.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy generosity which hath encompassed all things, and by Thy Command whereby the Trump was sounded and those in the graves were raised, to make me steadfast in Thee and in Thy signs, and to cause me to cling to the hem of Thy mercy and bounty.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Command that sounded the Trump and raised the dead to be steadfast in God and His signs.

selected.text: O my Lord! Make me steadfast, then, in Thy love and establish me in Thy Cause in such wise that should Thy servants who are veiled by learning from Thy Self-Subsisting Name oppose me, their opposition to Thee and their turning away from Thee would not disturb me
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to remain steadfast even if those veiled by learning oppose him.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the movement of Thy Pen, whereby Thou hast stirred all created things, and by the light of Thy countenance, whereby Thou hast illumined the horizons, to make me steadfast and firm in Thy Cause in such wise that nothing whatsoever shall prevent me.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the movement of the Pen for steadfastness that nothing whatsoever can prevent.

selected.text: O my God, my Lord, my Support, my Beloved, and my Hope! I beseech Thee by Thy tender mercies which have preceded all created things and by Thy mercy which hath encompassed all contingent beings, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm and immovable in Thy love.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by God’s mercy that precedes all things to be steadfast and immovable.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the breathings of Thy Revelation and the manifestations of Thy sovereignty in Thy lands to send down upon me from the heaven of Thy bounty and generosity that which will make me steadfast in Thy love, firm in Thy service, and vocal in Thy praise.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for what makes him steadfast in love, firm in service and vocal in praise.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the Ark of Thy Cause which sailed upon the sea of names through Thy will and power, to aid Thy male and female servants who have aimed for the ultimate goal and the supreme height to remain steadfast in Thy love and in the exaltation of Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Ark of the Cause for His male and female servants who aimed for the supreme height to remain steadfast in love.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest them clinging to the cord of Thy obedience and holding fast to the hem of the robe of Thy mercy. They have turned with their all unto Thee and desire to act according to what Thou hast commanded them in Thy Scriptures and Thy Tablets and Thy Books
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for those clinging to the cord of obedience who desire to act by the Scriptures, Tablets and Books; names obedience directly.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to ordain for me from the ocean of Thy bounty that which befitteth Thy generosity, then send down upon me from the heaven of Thy grace that which will make me steadfast in Thy Cause and regardful in all conditions of the horizon of Thy good-pleasure
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for what befits divine generosity and keeps him steadfast and regardful of God’s good-pleasure in all conditions.

selected.text: O my Lord, I am he who hath turned his face toward the court of Thy grace and bounties. Therefore, O my God, deprive me not of what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, and make me steadfast in the Cause from which the feet of every rejected idolater have slipped.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer not to be deprived of what was ordained for the chosen ones and to remain steadfast where idolaters slipped.

selected.text: O Lord! Make easy for him that which is difficult, enlighten his conscience, ordain for him abundant good, and make firm his footsteps on the straight path, attracted to the manifest light, mindful of Thy wondrous remembrance, and supplicating to Thy exalted Kingdom.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that difficulties be made easy, conscience enlightened and footsteps made firm on the straight path for the one prayed for.

selected.text: O Thou through Whose Name the horizon of praise was illumined and by Whose Call the people of creation were stirred to motion, ordain that I may stand firm in Thy service, utter Thy remembrance, serve Thy Cause, and act according to what Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition to stand firm in service, utter remembrance, serve the Cause and act by the Book; draws together the outward forms of obedience.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the sun of Thy grace hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of Thy Revelation and the ocean of Thy bounty hath surged amongst Thy creatures, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in the service of them who love Thee
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to be steadfast in the Cause and firm in the service of those who love God; links constancy with service to others.

selected.text: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy throne, by the ordinances of Thy Book, by the fragrances of Thy verses and by the manifestations of Thy grandeur, to make me in all conditions to turn toward Thy most exalted horizon, to speak Thy praise, O Lord of all names
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition by the ordinances of the Book to turn in all conditions toward the most exalted horizon; ties constancy to the laws of the Book.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Light which shone forth before the creation of the sun and its radiance, and by Thy Mercy which hath preceded the earth and the heaven and all that is therein, to make me steadfast in Thy love and firm and immovable in Thy Cause.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s petition by the Light that shone before the sun to be made steadfast in love and immovable in the Cause.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou seest the Wronged One among His enemies. I beseech Thee by Thy sovereignty that hath subdued the names, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, and speaking in Thy praise, and arising to serve Thy loved ones. Then open before my face the door of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer beginning “Thou seest the Wronged One among His enemies,” asking steadfastness and service to the loved ones.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer as the poor one to be so steadfast that the howling of wolves will not keep him from God; a memorable image of opposition.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by Thyself and by Thy chosen ones to assist me to be steadfast in Thy Cause in such wise that names shall not hold me back from Thy Most Great Name, nor shall the might of the oppressors prevent me from turning to Thee and drawing near to the gate of Thy bounty.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Name that breathed the spirit of life into all things for steadfastness against the idolaters’ imaginings.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s counsel to hold the robe of the Lord and pray to remain steadfast where the learned slipped.

selected.text: O Lord! Ordain for us what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, then grant us the Kawthar of steadfastness in this Cause wherein the feet of Thy creatures have slipped and the hearts of those in Thy realms were shaken, save those who dwelt beneath the canopies of Thy mercy.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for recognizing the Dayspring of the Cause and plea to remain steadfast in this mighty Cause.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Fashioner of the world and Educator of the nations, Who art seated upon Thy most great throne, to make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause in such wise that neither the books of the world shall mislead me nor the doubts of the nations cause me to slip.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that neither the books of the world mislead nor the doubts of the nations cause him to slip.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to the King of Kings for steadfastness in the Cause and in holding the cord of love.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the tablets of fire not prevent the loved ones from beholding the lights of God’s countenance.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the tears of the sincere for steadfastness unshaken by doubters and the cawing of crows.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for the evanescent one at the door of mercy and the thirsty one turning to the ocean of bounty; the guide’s thirsty-soul image.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for guidance to the Dayspring of Revelation, asking by the movement of the Pen to be steadfast in this Cause.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer, holding the cord of glory and the hem of might, to be preserved beneath the Tree of the Cause and given the choice wine that keeps him steadfast.

selected.text: Deprive us not, O our God, of the fragrances of Thy sanctity, then make us steadfast in Thy Cause, establish for us a truthful station with Thee, and grant us from Thy presence mercy, and join us with those servants of Thine who soar on the wings of glory in the atmosphere of holiness.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s communal prayer for steadfastness, a truthful station and union with those who soar on the wings of glory.

selected.text: O Lord! selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that hearts be steadfast in love amidst humanity and eyes illumined, with these blessings made lasting.

selected.text: "My God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward Thee. I beseech Thee to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee. selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s quoted prayer to be drawn near and aided in remembrance, praise and steadfastness in the Most Great Cause and Mighty News.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Creator of the heavens, by the ocean of Thy names and by Thy Name at Whose manifestation the dwellers of the earthly and heavenly kingdoms did prostrate themselves, to preserve me and strengthen me to remain steadfast in Thy Cause, the most mighty, ancient and all-glorious.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Name before which both kingdoms prostrated to be preserved and strengthened in the Cause.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the fragrances of Thy days and the manifestations of Thy greatness in Thy lands to assist them that have turned toward the Most Great Steadfastness, that the doubts of the factions and the intimations of those who have denied the Beginning and the Return may not deter them.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that those who turned to the Most Great Steadfastness not be deterred by the doubts of factions and deniers of the Beginning and the Return.

selected.text: O my God, my Beloved, and my Purpose! Thou seest me acknowledging Thy unity and confessing Thy grandeur and sovereignty. selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s testimony that steadfastness cannot be established except through divine might and that the heart finds tranquillity only through God’s grace; a foundational statement of steadfastness as a gift.

selected.text: Keep me firm and steadfast in Your Covenant and Pact and make me unwavering in Your Testament and Faith, for the winds of test are severe and the tempest of trial raises dust. selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s urgent prayer for firmness in the Covenant because the winds of test are severe and the tempest of trial raises dust.

selected.text: My God, my God! I have turned toward Thee, holding fast to the cord of Thy bounty and clinging to the hem of Thy generosity. selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer, holding the cord of bounty and hem of generosity, to be steadfast in love and firm in the Cause.

selected.text: My God, my God! selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer for beautiful patience for the servants facing calamities, trials and tribulations.

selected.text: O my God! selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that the eyes of hearts be illumined and made steadfast against those who claim what the Book has not ordained.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer holding fast to the cord and clinging to the robe, asking to be made a helper of the Cause standing firm in service.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to hold the cord, cling to the robe and be immersed in the depths of the sea of oneness.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the Prophets and Messengers to hold the cord and robe in all conditions and stand firm in service.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by lands reddened with the blood of loved ones and the neck adorned with the rope in God’s path for steadfastness unshaken by doubts.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer for the good of both worlds and for steadfastness, firm service and praise amid the servants.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for a soul made content with the decree, holding to the cord of good-pleasure; relinquishing self-will.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the cries of those near in separation for steadfastness unshaken by the heedless and the oppressors.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s cumulative invocation by divine Name, Cause, might and majesty for steadfastness against the oppression of the wicked.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer from the hands of the heedless to hold fast to the Book and to deeds that waft divine good-pleasure, desiring only trustworthiness, religiousness, truthfulness and purity.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to serve, praise and be steadfast while soaring on the wings of detachment in the atmosphere of God’s will.

selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to the Lord of this world and the next to keep the believers steadfast in Cause and love and to act by what was sent down in the Book.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Book and the pearls of the ocean of Thy bounty to make me steadfast in Thy service and vocal in Thy praise. O my Lord! Thou seest the weary one making for the kingdom of Thy utterance, the sightless one for the heaven of Thy knowledge, and the feeble one for the horizon of Thy power. I beseech Thee, O God of the world and Speaker amongst the nations, by Thy grace and Thy hosts, and by Thy might and Thy grandeur, to make me in all conditions firm in Thy Cause and steadfast in Thy love.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer of the weary, sightless and feeble one turning to God’s utterance, knowledge and power for firmness.

selected.text: My God, my God! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I have turned with my whole being unto Thee. I beseech Thee by the breath of Thy Revelation, and by the Word wherewith Thou didst quicken Thy servants, and by the ocean of Thy knowledge and the heaven of Thy bounty, to make me in all conditions one who maketh mention of Thee and calleth out Thy Name and standeth firm in the service of Thy Cause. Verily Thou art powerful to do what Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Merciful, the All-Bountiful.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s complete prayer of one turned wholly to God, asking to make mention of Him and stand firm in service in all conditions.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the leaves of the Tree of Thy knowledge, and the fruits of the Tree of Thine utterance, and the cooing of the doves of Thy remembrance in Thy lands, and the warbling of the nightingales of Thy love in Thy dominion, to assist Thy loved ones to stand firm in Thy Cause, to hold fast to the cord of Thy bounty, and to cling to the hem of Thy grace in such wise that the oppression of the aggressive ones in Thy days shall not deter them, nor shall the doings of the wrongdoers prevent them from turning toward Thy horizon.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer by the doves and nightingales of remembrance that the loved ones stand firm undeterred by aggressors and wrongdoers.

selected.text: Take hold of the Book of God with the hand of submission and certitude, despite those who cast it behind their backs, and say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having strengthened me, caused me to recognize Thee, called me to Thy mighty announcement, and guided me to Thy straight path. … I beseech Thee, O Lord of the kingdom of earth and heaven and Sovereign of the realm of might, by Thy command through which Thou hast subdued the world, to make me in all conditions steadfast in Thy Cause, firm in Thy love, and speaking Thy praise amongst Thy servants
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s counsel to hold the Book with submission and certitude, followed by a prayer of thanks and constancy.

selected.text: O Lord! Make firm the feet of Thy loved ones in Thy Cause and make them steadfast in Thy love. Make their hearts illumined by the radiant rays from Thy most glorious Kingdom and their breasts dilated through Thy verses sent down from Thy most exalted Realm. O Lord! They are orphans who have taken refuge in the shelter of Thy protection, they are poor who have sought the shade of Thy shelter, they are lowly ones who have clung to the cord of Thy might and grace. Look upon them, therefore, with the eye of Thy mercy and make them a sign of Thy compassion amongst Thy creatures.
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer that the loved ones, likened to orphans, the poor and the lowly clinging to the cord of grace, be made firm and a sign of compassion among creatures.

selected.text: O God, O thou forgiving one! Shelter these homeless birds in the garden of fortitude and steadfastness upon the branches of the divine Lote Tree … May they become aflame through the heat of the love of God, weeping clouds in their separation from the beauty of the Generous One. May their faces become illumined through their faithfulness to God and may their hearts be gladdened as flower spangled meadows through His abounding grace. In the Cause of God may each one become as a manifest standard, and in steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament, may each be as a fortified stronghold
selected.reason: ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s prayer to shelter homeless birds in the garden of fortitude on the branches of the Lote Tree, each a fortified stronghold of the Covenant; a central image prayer.

selected.text: O my Lord! Praise be to Thee for Thy gracious gifts and wondrous bounties, whereby Thou hast caused me to recognize the Manifestation of Thy Self, honored me with His presence, made me hear His melodies, and brought me before Him. By Thy might! Were I to thank Thee for what Thou hast bestowed upon me throughout the duration of Thy sovereignty, it would still fall short of the wonders of Thy favors. But I beseech Thee by the sovereignty of Thy Name that hath encompassed all created things, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, speaking in praise of Thy Self, and mindful of Thy wondrous gifts.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for recognizing and attaining the presence of the Manifestation, admitting that no thanks could match His favors.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst open the door of Thy mercy unto the faces of Thy servants and didst aid them that were detached through the hosts of Thy wisdom and Thy utterance, to assist Thy servants to perform that from which the fragrance of Thy good-pleasure may be wafted. O my Lord! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I have turned to Thee, beseeching the ocean of Thy favor and the heaven of Thy bounty. O my Lord! Aid me to serve Thee with such steadfastness as cannot be hindered by names nor by what the opposing parties possess.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer to serve with such steadfastness as cannot be hindered by names nor by what the opposing parties possess; a complete petition joining service and constancy.

selected.text: My God, my God! The fragrance of Thy raiment hath been diffused throughout Thy realms and the tokens of Thy greatness have been spread abroad throughout Thy lands. By Thy glory, O Thou the Goal of the world and the Beloved of the nations! The breezes of Thy Revelation have so carried me away that I have turned toward Thy most exalted horizon, clinging to the cord of Thy grace, O Thou Lord of Names and Creator of heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy Cause to ordain for me through the Pen of Thy Command that which Thou didst ordain for Thy chosen ones who attained unto the Greater Steadfastness in such wise that the oppression of the world did not deter them
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer of one carried away by the breezes of Revelation to share the Greater Steadfastness of chosen ones whom the world’s oppression did not deter.

selected.text: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having manifested me through Thy power and enabled me to serve Thee and caused me to speak Thy praise and illumined me with the light of Thy knowledge. I beseech Thee, O Lord of the Kingdom, by the mysteries of the Realm of Might and the lights of Thy countenance whereby the realm of creation was illumined, and by Thy Most Great Book which speaketh before the faces of the nations, to assist me and Thy loved ones to remain steadfast in such wise that neither the promptings of the evil ones, nor the doubts of the deniers, nor the insinuations of those who have disbelieved in the Day of Judgment shall keep them back.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s thanks for being enabled to serve and praise, asking that he and the loved ones stay steadfast against evil promptings and doubts.

selected.text: My God, my God! I testify to Thy oneness and Thy unity, and that this Day is Thy Day, and this Cause is Thy Cause. Thou hast manifested and made clear Thy path, and sent down from the heaven of utterance Thy proof. I testify that no cause can withstand Thy Cause, and no power can rival Thy power. I beseech Thee by the Dayspring of Thy signs and the Dawning-Place of Thy clear tokens and the mines of Thy wisdom and the repositories of Thy knowledge, and by the Light wherewith Thou hast illumined the world, and by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued the nations, to make me steadfast in Thy love, detached from all else but Thee, attracted by Thy verses, and enkindled with the fire of Thy sacred Tree.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s testimony that this Day is God’s Day and no cause can withstand His Cause, leading to a prayer for steadfast love and detachment.

selected.text: O my God and my Master! I am he who hath turned his face toward the seat of Thy throne, and I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which all who are in the heavens and on earth were shaken, save those whom Thou didst preserve through Thy grace and didst number among the sincere ones, that Thou withhold not from me the wonders of Thy gifts and favors, and that the sweet fragrances of Thy mercy and bestowals be not cut off from me. Verily Thou art the Omnipotent over what Thou willest, and Thou art the All-Compelling, the Almighty, the Powerful, the All-Glorious. O Lord! Make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause in such wise that my feet shall not slip even though all created things should oppose me.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer that his feet not slip even though all created things oppose him.

selected.text: O my Lord! Thou knowest that I have turned towards Thee and hastened to the place wherein He Who is the Manifestation of Thy Self, the Dawning-Place of Thy verses and the Dayspring of Thy evidences was imprisoned. Had it not been for Thy grace and bounty, how could I have attained unto this station from which Thy servants and creatures were debarred? Praise be to Thee, O my God, for that which Thou hast honored me through Thy generosity and bestowed upon me through Thy grace. I beseech Thee, O Thou Who art the Ultimate Hope of the sincere ones and the Beloved of the hearts of the lovers, to aid me in serving Thee and in promoting Thy Cause amongst Thy servants and creatures, and to make me one of those who have partaken of the wine of steadfastness and assurance and have attained unto that which Thou didst desire for them, O Thou Who art the Lord of Religions and the Creator of the worlds.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s prayer of a pilgrim who hastened to the place of the Manifestation’s imprisonment, asking for the wine of steadfastness and assurance.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having mentioned me through Thy most great signs, from which everyone possessed of perception perceiveth the fragrance of eternity. Glory be to Thee for having caused me to hear the rustling of Thy Most Exalted Pen and shown me Thy signs and most sublime words. I bear witness, O my God, to Thy oneness and Thy singleness, and that Thou art God, there is none other God but Thee. Thou hast ever been supreme over the kingdom of earth and heaven. Through Thy name the banner of "He doeth what He willeth" was raised. I beseech Thee, O Creator of heaven and Sovereign of the Kingdom of Names, by the power of Thy Will and the manifestation of Thy Purpose, and by the Beloved through Whose advent the heavens of Thy might were honored, and by the Spirit whom Thou didst raise to the horizon of Thy Cause, and by the Rod that vanquished the swords and through which the stars of Thine enemies were dimmed and Pharaoh and his hosts were drowned by Thy might and power, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love, such that names shall not prevent me from drawing near unto Thee, nor shall the gulf of idle fancies debar me from turning toward the shore of the ocean of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s complete prayer recalling the Rod that drowned Pharaoh’s hosts, asking that names and idle fancies not keep him from God.

selected.text: O believer in God! Your letter was received and read. May the new-born be blessed. Pray and supplicate and say: "O God! selected.reason: A prayer for a child’s faith, wisdom and steadfastness.
